blocks.content: NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) is the premier policy think tank of the Government of India. It was established to replace the Planning Commission and aims to promote cooperative federalism, sustainable development, and strategic policy-making.
NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) is the premier policy think tank of the Government of India.

items: NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission of India.
Full Expansion: National Institution for Transforming India.
Key Exam Focus: Promotes 'cooperative federalism' and sustainable development as a policy think tank.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: NITI Aayog stands for National Institution for Transforming India.
It serves as the premier policy think tank for the Government of India.
It was established to replace the legacy Planning Commission.
Its core objectives are fostering cooperative federalism, driving sustainable development, and guiding strategic policy-making.
